game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the volcanologist must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ash bricks is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Convert units using expressions so each trade of ash bricks is fair. Each round, ember hounds strike the fire shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fair_trades value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fire shrine from ember hounds in Sulfur Springs: keep the fair_trades meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: fair_trades drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Unit Trader
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sulfur Springs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fair_trades changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Sulfur Springs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while fair_trades > 0.
